summary: Keep Mealie recipes handy in a counter-friendly cooking view. Needs an account.
page_description: A read-only Mealie companion. Pick tonight's recipe and cook one large step at a time, with the screen kept on and the recipe available offline.
release_notes: Ingredients are ticked off in checkboxes, servings change with minus and plus, and the Mealie address is typed on Cobalt's own keyboard. Tonight's recipe and the connect screen fit the largest text size.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already. Mealie must be reachable over HTTPS.
In Mealie, create an API token (your profile, API Tokens).
Connect Kitchen Card from your computer. It asks for the address and the token, checks them, and sets the app up. Open Kitchen Card, or tap Check again.
